title: One and Three Chairs (HTTP)
summary: Kosuth's object/image/definition triptych, where the object panel is a real but unrenderable <chair> element because the web has no chairs.
mechanism: A live unknown <chair> HTML element renders as nothing beside a per-visit procedurally generated SVG chair and a fixed dictionary definition; absence is structural, attested in console.
references: Joseph Kosuth, One and Three Chairs (1965)
Walter Benjamin, The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction (1935)
